title: Outstanding Oven Roasted Brazilian Malai Skewers
description: A resinous and velvety Brazilian dish featuring malai, perfect for a date night, with a low sodium content for a healthier option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together malai cream, lime juice, garlic powder, paprika, and salt-free seasoning.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and mix until they are well coated with the malai mixture.
Thread the chicken pieces onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the skewers in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, turning them halfway through the cooking time.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and lime wedges if desired.
